interpretations.reservation_expiry: Planned leave time expires the reservation; missed entry expires after enter+2s and cannot rebook until next step. Encounter means current inside/request relation to the same passage.
interpretations.waiting_grid: Global 0.05m lattice; robots pick nearest point to their current location, tie by exit distance then coordinates.
interpretations.head_on_role: Only selection is filtered by heading cosine; original inactivity rule controls reassignment.
